messages:
claire_csm: Quick note — Meridian tenant goes live 08:30 PT. I created a short "sanity + feedback" runbook focused on prefill, warm cache, streaming handshake, and a 1-click feedback capture in the kickoff email. Please review and ack.

raj_sre: Ack. Ops TL;DR: prefill top 10 prompts to KV, warm cache_ttl=25s. Ramp plan: 0 -> 30% (10m) -> 70% (25m) -> 100% (50m). Start with batching disabled for first 4m, then enable batch_size=3, batch_window_ms=180. If p50 jumps > 250ms compared to baseline after any step, rollback and set batch_size=1 + disable streaming. Page if p95 > 900ms for 10m.

emily_te: Adding a tiny programmatic toggle example for CSM automation (Python):
```python
import requests
API = 'https://control.redwood.example/v1/tenants/meridian/toggle'
resp = requests.post(API, json={"enable_streaming": False, "batch_size": 1}, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $TOKEN"})
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```
Also adding curl streaming smoke for onboarding script:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"meridian-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .stream_open
```
Expect true.

oscar_pm: Renewal-watch rule suggestion: if week-1 DAU < 12% forecast AND rolling-6h avg error_rate > 1.4% OR rolling-6h p95 latency > 800ms -> create renewal_alert and assigned CSM outreach within 18h. CSM pre-call checklist: confirm API keys, run streaming handshake, verify KV prefill count, check last 24h fallback_model use.

claire_csm: For feedback capture I'm proposing a 1-click inline poll in the kickoff email: Good / Okay / Bad (latency). I'll use the webhook to capture responses and tag tickets. Also adding a tiny SQL snippet for CSMs to quickly check cohort usage: 
```sql
SELECT day, active_users FROM tenant_metrics WHERE tenant_id='meridian' AND day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY day;
```
Would like an automated watch that runs this daily for first 7 days.

emily_te: Runbook fallback sequence on backpressure: 1) toggle enable_streaming=false 2) set batch_size=1 3) switch to fallback_model=meridian-lite 4) if p95 > 1s for > 10m, escalate to SRE. I'll add these steps to onboarding scripts and a small health-check endpoint that returns {"ok":true, "latency_ms":...}.

raj_sre: On-call quick commands (kubectl-friendly):
```bash
# disable streaming for tenant
kubectl patch tenant meridian --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"enableStreaming":false}}'
# force batch_size=1
kubectl patch tenant meridian --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"batchSize":1}}'
```
I'll add to eng-oncall doc.

helper-bot: monitor: meridian.* p50_latency, p95_latency, error_rate, kv_miss_rate. Alerts: p95>900ms or error_rate>1.5% -> page. Daily cohort watch created for first 7d.

claire_csm: Thanks team — action items: oscar finalize kickoff copy with 1-click poll, emily add smoke scripts + health-check, raj add on-call snippets and alerts, I'll monitor cohort/watch and post flags. Will report back at T+12h. :eyes:
